req.title: Reject duplicate playerId on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with an ID that already exists.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject duplicate player IDs with an HTTP 409 Conflict response. This behavior ensures data integrity by preventing the creation of players with duplicate squad numbers. The test suite includes a positive test to verify successful player creation, a negative test to check for duplicate rejection, and a boundary test to ensure the system handles edge cases correctly.

tests.name: test_create_new_player_success
preconditions: The player with squad number 27 does not exist in the database.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a unique squad number 27.
expected: The response contains the created player's data.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

new_player = {
    "firstName": "Test",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=new_player)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["squadNumber"] == 27

tests.name: test_reject_duplicate_player_id
preconditions: A player with squad number 10 already exists in the database.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with squad number 10.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating a conflict.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

duplicate_player = {
    "firstName": "Duplicate",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=duplicate_player)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert "A Player with this squad number already exists." in response.json()["detail"]

tests.name: test_boundary_squad_number
preconditions: The player with squad number 26 exists in the database.
The player with squad number 27 does not exist in the database.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with squad number 26.
Send a POST request to /players/ with squad number 27.
expected: The first response status code is 409.
The second response status code is 201.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

boundary_player_26 = {
    "firstName": "Boundary",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 26,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": True
}

boundary_player_27 = {
    "firstName": "Boundary",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": True
}

response_26 = client.post("/players/", json=boundary_player_26)
assert response_26.status_code == 409

response_27 = client.post("/players/", json=boundary_player_27)
assert response_27.status_code == 201
assert response_27.json()["squadNumber"] == 27
